name: Pre-commit execution

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [precommit-run]

jobs:
  cancel_previous:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          all_but_latest: true
          only_status: "in_progress"

  precommit:
    needs: cancel_previous
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.client_payload.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Run pre-commit
        uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1
        with:
          extra_args: --all-files

      - name: Commit changes
        id: commit
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "chore: run pre-commit fixes"
          author_name: "github-actions[bot]"
          author_email: "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          cwd: .
          push: true
          pull: false
          new_branch: ${{ github.event.client_payload.ref }}

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ✅ Pre-commit hooks executed and changes committed.
            Commit: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.commit_sha }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.client_payload.pull_number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
